lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the posterior lateral flank, arranged in three primary vertical columns with approximately four distinct centroids per column within the high-contrast region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, forming a discernible rectangular lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the superior edge to lower luminance shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, randomly dispersed high-luminance spots, distinct from the ordered grid observed on the lateral flank.
